reviews.title: Most Recent Update
reviews.text:
If you’ve ever played a video game post 2022 and thought “does nobody play test games anymore…?” you will now have a similar experience with Opera after the most recent update. Whoever designed and or greenlit the most recent changes to this browser’s mobile version should be sacked more or less immediately.

 There is virtually no aspect of the experience that has not been made inferior to past versions of itself. Easily swipeable tabs have been replaced with tiles that display far less and are objectively more challenging to close, seemingly every aspect of the UI has been redesigned to be clunkier to navigate and less intelligible, from how to switch tabs, enter private browsing, even the options in the hamburger menu have been further nested to make them more obnoxious to access. Someone really thought to themselves “we should inception some of this useful stuff. You know. Make it harder for the idiots who use our app to find!” Speaking of googling, good luck with that. Opera no longer functions for more than a 30 second browsing experience before something goes wrong. Hyperlinks become unclickable, the search bar greys itself out and refuses to accept pastes or it will simply fail to load a webpage you loaded seconds before for no discernible reason while safari manages just fine. In fairness, if it is your first time using the browser then the performance issues are all you’re likely to notice. And you’ll notice them quickly. Try sifting through a wiki. After the third

reviews.title: Worst browser lacking basic features
reviews.text: I started using Opera because I had a set of about 20 tabs I needed to use on a daily basis that I didn't want getting cluttered with my other Safari tabs and groups. I can't believe how bad Opera is - shockingly bad. First, there is no reload button or other way to reload the page like pulling down from the top. If you want to reload you have to copy the address bar and paste it into a new tab which is obviously ridiculous. Second, it doesn't hold history properly. The websites I'm visiting would sometimes take me to a human verification page. When hitting the back button to get back to my original page, Opera would take me to a blank start page, completely forgetting I was ever on the original page. Even long pressing showed that it had no history I was ever on the other page. On top of these two major issues, I found it to be overall slow and unstable. Literally the worst browser I've ever used in my life. Deleted.
